relevant_changes: Defines control functions and operational performance requirements for PV direct-driven appliance controllers coordinating power from sources such as PV, grid and storage to appliances such as heaters, refrigeration, air-conditioning and pumps.
Controller requirements apply to systems up to 1 500 V DC or 1 000 V AC.
Safety and EMC requirements for the controller are explicitly not covered by this document.
It references separate safety requirements for PV, grid and storage converters, and converter performance references IEC 62093.
